Job Title: Data Science Intern
Company: Pinecrest Analytics Pvt Ltd
Location: Bengaluru, India
Work mode: Hybrid (3 days in office)
Job Type: Internship (6 months)

Key Responsibilities
- Clean and analyse customer datasets using Pandas and SQL.
- Build dashboards in Power BI for the sales team.

Eligibility Criteria
- B.Tech / M.Tech students graduating in 2026.
- Minimum CGPA of 7.0 with no active backlogs.

Skills Required
- Python programming.
- Good understanding of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.
- Excellent written and verbal communication in English.

Good to have
- Knowledge of scikit-learn or TensorFlow.

Stipend: Rs. 40,000 per month
Last date to apply: 15/08/2026
